segments.an8.60:1.1: “Aṭṭhime, bhikkhave, puggalā āhuneyyā … pe … anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
segments.an8.60:1.3: Sotāpanno, sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno … pe … arahā, arahattāya paṭipanno.
segments.an8.60:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭha puggalā āhuneyyā … pe … anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti.
segments.an8.60:2.1: “Cattāro ca paṭipannā, cattāro ca phale ṭhitā;
segments.an8.60:2.3: Esa saṅgho samukkaṭṭho, sattānaṃ aṭṭha puggalā.
segments.an8.60:3.3: Karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ, ettha dinnaṃ mahapphalan”ti.
segments.an8.60:4.1: Gotamī ovādaṃ saṃkhittaṃ, dīghajāṇu ca ujjayo;
segments.an8.60:4.3: Bhayā dve āhuneyyā ca, dve ca aṭṭha puggalāti.
